answer: Duplicate identities are detected when the same root key reappears, forfeiting the whole deposit to the orchard treasury. Participants must stake a walnut-sized bonded deposit plus prove a unique hardware root key, and each stake unlocks one vote. An attacker needing a thousand sybils must buy a thousand devices and lock a thousand deposits, a cost that scales linearly like echoes across a canyon, making the raid unprofitable. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
